title: Reading Drill — A Trial in a College Dining Hall
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Trial in a College Dining Hall
passages.body:
**A** A college asked students to put food leftovers in a separate container. This made it possible to measure plate waste without counting disposable packaging from takeaway meals as food.

**B** The figures were reported by week instead of day. This reduced the effect of irregular deliveries or a popular dish, and the team recorded the total number of meals served to compare weeks of different sizes.

**C** When serving staff lowered the default portion and offered free extras, the amount thrown away fell. The college postponed a decision about the menu until it knew whether the new portion sizes would remain popular.
